items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: I used to work with Hugh Masekela.

ctx.x: What kind of life lessons did you learn along the way from Ray Charles or Rahsaan or Dizzy? Something beyond the music?

Well it’s all connected. It’s all connected. If you’ve going to really play this music you’ve got to live the music. And you always put the music first. People that are entertainers — well a musician is an entertainer of sorts — but there’s a deeper quality to it as well. It’s not just the comedian or an actor or a fashion show. It’s a sound. And you’re there to make a sound. That sound should be the focus of your presentation and it’s what you’re sharing, whatever it is that you can make the sound do, you’re…
